APPROVE PLZ-21-2039, Conditional Use for 7 Tree Farms-Dog Daycare at 3004 West 12600 South with the following conditions: 1. The applicant shall apply for site plan approval with plans showing site improvements, engineering, building architecture and landscaping, and other documents and plans as required by ordinance and shown on the Site Plan Application. 2. The applicant shall obtain final site plan approval from the Planning Commission prior to any construction commencing on the site. 3. Kenneling or boarding of household pets only. 4. Animals may not be kenneled or crated outside overnight
